notes: Events are patients with serious adverse events: 28 in the tocilizumab group and 12 in the placebo group. The report separately states 36 and 38 serious adverse event episodes, respectively. Denominators are from Table 4, Adverse Events in the Safety Population. The modified intention-to-treat population instead has 161 tocilizumab patients and 81 placebo patients; one patient intubated before receiving placebo was excluded from that population but included in the safety population. Percentages for patients with any serious adverse event are NOT_IN_PACKET. A 28-day follow-up period is described for efficacy outcomes, but an explicit serious-adverse-event assessment window is NOT_IN_PACKET.
